name: Do you think we're soulmates in every universe?
source:
Have you seen the trend that was making its rounds on TikTok and other corners of the internet where you ask the question: Do you think we're soulmates in every universe? Whether or not you have, this visual novel is a short little game about your partner asking you that exact question.

[From [url=https://goldenarc.itch.io/do-you-think-were-soulmates-in-every-universe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否看到了TikTok和互联网其他角落流行的趋势，你会提出这样的问题：你认为我们在每个宇宙中都是灵魂伴侣吗？无论你是否有，这部视觉小说都是一个简短的小游戏，你的伴侣会问你这个确切的问题。

[来自[url=https://goldenarc.itch.io/do-you-think-were-soulmates-in-every-universe]Itch.io[/url]]
